fullTitle: Arousal Scoring — Essentials of Sleep Technology
publisher: The Atlanta School of Sleep Medicine and Technology
apaCitation: The Atlanta School of Sleep Medicine and Technology. (n.d.). Arousal scoring [Slide presentation].
bestFor: Visual review of arousal recognition, NREM versus REM arousal logic, common non-arousal lookalikes, alpha intrusion, and a practical arousal-scoring workflow.
copyrightUse: Use the presentation to inform original Sleep Pathways Guild explanations and original/synthetic practice examples. Do not reproduce source PSG screenshots, slide images, proprietary examples, or source questions.
authorityBoundary: Historical instructional presentation. It references older scoring-manual-era material and is not a current scoring authority. Current AASM scoring guidance controls rule-sensitive content.
currencyNote: Publication date is not identified in the uploaded presentation. Treat all scoring criteria as requiring current AASM verification before learner release.
mappingBoundary: Mapped to adult scoring for instructional review only. The presentation's examples are not imported as answer keys or production waveform assets.
